course_name_en: Vocational Pedagogy 1 and Vocational Field Internship

learning_outcomes.text: understand vocational pedagogy as a sub-discipline of educational science, are able to differentiate the respective subject areas and research fields from each other and explain them in context.
are able to identify requirements for company and school educational personnel and understand vocational pedagogy as a profession in this context.

can present structures, forms, models and interfaces of the vocational education system in Germany in a differentiated manner and consider historical, educational policy and legal framework conditions.
use methods and tools of scientific work.
systematically reflect exemplary practical experiences and also examine motives for their own career choice.

syllabus_topics: Concepts, subject areas and research fields of educational science as well as vocational pedagogy as an educational science sub-discipline
Structures, forms, models and interfaces of the vocational education system
Actors and roles in the vocational education system
Tools for scientific work: word processing program, literature management program
Methods of scientific work: researching, source work, text production
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination and proof of performance. The grading importance for the final grade is according to the study and examination regulations (SPO).
